newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt to give verdict in Israel spy case on Aug 31.
newsitem.headline: Egypt to give verdict in Israel spy case on Aug 31.

text.p: Egyptian judges will give a verdict on August 31 on an Israeli man and his alleged Egyptian accomplice on charges they spied in Egypt, the main judge told a hearing in the trial on Monday.
Israeli Druze textile technician Azam Azam and Egyptian Emad Abdelhalim Ismail have pleaded not guilty to charges they made criminal arrangements to spy for the Israeli intelligence service Mossad.
Two Israeli Druze women -- Zahra Youssef Greiss and Mona Ahmed Shawahna -- are on trial in absentia for the same charges.
The case, which began on April 24, brought Egypt-Israeli ties to one of their lowest ebbs since their 1979 peace treaty.
